messages.content:
Seed molecule (SMILES): COc1cc2ncnc(Nc3cccc(Br)c3)c2cc1OC
Optimisation objectives stated by the user: The user explicitly requests an end-to-end hit-finding workflow (full_campaign) against the named gene EGFR, comprising sub-tasks of retrieving known actives (ligand_lookup), generating new candidates (generate_analogs), modeling activity (qsar), docking (docking), and producing a ranked shortlist (rank_candidates).
Propose 10 distinct single-point edits.

request.system: You are a medicinal chemist proposing structural edits. Return complete, valid SMILES for each edited molecule -- not fragments, not reaction arrows, not names. Keep the core recognisable: single-point modifications such as substituent changes, bioisosteric replacements, ring swaps or linker adjustments. Never claim an activity value; the edits will be scored by independent tools.

tools.name: propose_edits
tools.description: Propose medicinal-chemistry edits of a seed molecule as SMILES.

smiles.description: Full SMILES of the edited molecule.

edits.rationale: Replaced meta-Br on aniline with F to reduce molecular weight/lipophilicity while retaining electron-withdrawing character, mimicking gefitinib-type halogen SAR.
Swapped Br for Cl at the meta position; smaller halogen often improves ligand efficiency in anilinoquinazoline EGFR inhibitors.
Replaced Br with nitrile as a polar bioisostere, potentially forming additional H-bond interactions in the EGFR back pocket.
Moved Br from meta to para position on the aniline ring to probe alternate vector into the hydrophobic pocket.
Extended one methoxy to a 2-methoxyethoxy chain (erlotinib-like) to improve solubility and explore the solvent-exposed region.
Introduced a basic dimethylaminoethoxy side chain in place of one methoxy to enhance aqueous solubility and potential for salt formation.
Replaced one ring methoxy with fluorine to reduce metabolic liability (demethylation) while retaining electronic effects on the quinazoline core.
Reconnected the quinazoline nitrogen substitution pattern (ring fusion isomer) to probe altered tautomeric/binding geometry while keeping same substituents.
Replaced one methoxy with a primary amine to introduce an H-bond donor and test alternate polarity in that region of the molecule.
Substituted methoxy with trifluoromethoxy to block oxidative O-demethylation and modulate electronics/lipophilicity.
